zh.headline: GPT-6.2 透明度不及 Claude
headline_alt: 编码 Agent 实测不足一成任务完成
黎曼猜想证明获 Lean 社区确认
zh.observation: 今天最值得警惕的信号来自评测层：METR 说模型进步快过评测能力，编码 Agent 职场基准又显示真实任务完成率不足一成——两者叠加，意味着当下很多“能力宣称”缺乏可信度量。与此同时，Lean 社区正式确认黎曼猜想证明，说明形式化验证正在成为 AI 科研成果的可信仲裁机制，这可能比模型本身更值得投入。产业侧，银行封禁第三方 Agent、低成本推理商窃取密钥两件事共同指向同一个结论：Agent 的信任与安全边界，正在成为落地的真正瓶颈。

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 回答更简洁，透明度却落后 Claude
items.desc: OpenAI 新模型的回答更短、更直接，但更不愿承认不确定性；Anthropic 的 Claude 系列在透明度评测中明显领先。
items.value: 选型时需权衡“简洁”与“诚实”，高风险场景慎用

items.title: NVIDIA 发布 Alpamayo 2 Edge：面向 DRIVE Thor 的 2B 推理 VLA
items.desc: 该模型能规划驾驶轨迹并解释原因，像素到轨迹延迟仅 160–190ms，可部署于车端。
items.value: 小参数 VLA 上车，端侧自动驾驶推理路线可参考

items.title: Google 在 Gemini API 预览 Tool Retrieval
items.desc: Agent 可常驻大型工具库，仅在需要时在单次 Interactions API 请求内加载对应参数 schema。
items.value: 直接缓解大工具库的上下文膨胀与成本问题

items.title: Perplexity 推出 Monitor API
items.desc: 按计划搜索网页，仅在检测到相关变化时通过 webhook 通知 Agent，内置决策模型过滤噪声。
items.value: 把搜索从一次性查询变成可持续的监控型 Agent 能力

items.title: AWS 推出 TorchNeuron：PyTorch 模型无需修改即可跑在 Trainium 上
items.desc: 降低非 NVIDIA 加速卡的使用门槛。
items.value: 迁移成本下降，Trainium 生态竞争力提升

items.title: 美国大银行封禁第三方 AI Agent 登录账户
items.desc: 多家金融机构禁止第三方 bot 接入用户账户，并声明 bot 造成的损失由用户自行承担。
items.value: 个人金融 Agent 落地遇合规硬墙，产品设计需提前规避

items.title: METR 警告：模型进步快过安全评测能力
items.desc: Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra 在研究型任务上快速提升却越来越难测量，现有数据无法排除危险的加速；同时常见测试可能高估模型实际能力。
items.value: 评测方法本身成为瓶颈，benchmark 可信度需重新审视

items.title: OpenAI 首席科学家谈如何为 AI 发展“限速”
items.desc: 核心难点在于先就“如何测量速度”达成共识。
items.value: 治理讨论转向可量化指标，评测标准或成政策抓手

items.title: 编码 Agent 在模拟职场中完成率不足 10%
items.desc: 新基准把 Agent 放进带同事、项目看板和不完整交接的模拟开发岗位，Opus 5.5 与 Astra 均远未达标——孤立测试表现优秀，自主长期开发则失焦。
items.value: 暴露“刷榜”与真实工程能力之间的巨大鸿沟

items.title: Lean/Mathlib 社区正式确认 Levent Alpöge 的黎曼猜想证明正确
items.desc: 数十位独立验证者核查了 1700 万行代码，比 Terence Tao 预计的 2050 年提前数十年。
items.value: 形式化验证成为 AI 数学成果的可信仲裁机制

items.title: TensorLean：在 PTX 层形式化验证 GPU kernel
items.desc: 来自 Columbia 与 CertiK，检查 149 个 kernel 实例，证明 83 个正确，并在 FlashAttention、DeepGEMM 等中发现 38 个 bug。
items.value: 为高性能算子提供可证明的正确性保障

items.title: LightningMoBA：动态路由 + KV 中心执行加速块稀疏注意力
items.desc: 针对 MoBA 固定 Top-k 预算与 query 中心调度的缺陷，联合设计选择与执行。
items.value: 长上下文推理提速的直接工程路径

items.title: 腾讯元宝 × KCL 发布首个基于群聊构建的 Agent 记忆基准
items.desc: 用 8 万条群聊消息构造考卷，检验 Agent 的长期记忆能力。
items.value: 为 Agent 记忆能力提供贴近真实场景的评测集

items.title: Claude-BugHunter 单日涨星 1716
items.desc: Claude Code 技能包，含 82 个技能、15 个 slash 命令、覆盖 24 类漏洞的 681 条公开报告模式，面向红队与漏洞挖掘。
items.value: 安全场景的 Agent 技能工程可直接复用

items.title: DeepSeek V1 作者创业项目开源，专为本地部署的 Agent
items.desc: 主打本地化运行的 Agent 框架。
items.value: 本地部署 Agent 再添一个高关注度选项

items.title: Karpo 新作开源：浏览器 Agent 兼顾速度与效果
items.desc: 此前曾反超 Gemini。
items.value: 浏览器自动化 Agent 的性能标杆参考

items.title: localcode：一条命令在 Mac 上跑开源 agentic coding
items.desc: 本地运行的编码 Agent 工具。
items.value: 低门槛体验本地编码 Agent

items.title: Agent swarm 挑战 P vs. NP 引发技术圈激辩
items.desc: pequalnp.com 用 Agent 群体尝试攻克 P vs. NP，HN 上 92 分、82 条评论；ACM 同步发文回顾“2026 年秋发生了什么：AI 与 P vs. NP”。讨论焦点在于：多 Agent 协作产出的数学结果能否被验证、又该如何解读。
items.value: Agent 群体用于前沿科研的可行性与可信度之争

items.title: “你是一个 LLM 的 subagent”游戏登上 HN 热榜
items.desc: Show HN 作品 worker755 让玩家扮演 LLM 的子代理执行任务，266 分、61 条评论，折射出开发者对 Agent 层级协作与“被调度”体验的集体共鸣。
items.value: 从游戏化视角理解 subagent 编排的真实痛点

en.headline: GPT-6.2 falls short of Claude on transparency
headline_alt: Coding agents tested: fewer than 10% of tasks completed
Riemann Hypothesis proof confirmed by Lean community
en.observation: Today's most alarming signal comes from the evaluation layer: METR says models are improving faster than evaluation capabilities, while a coding Agent workplace benchmark shows a real-task completion rate below ten percent—together, this means many current "capability claims" lack credible measurement. Meanwhile, the Lean community has formally confirmed a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, showing that formal verification is becoming a credible arbitration mechanism for AI research results, which may be more worth investing in than the models themselves. On the industry side, banks banning third-party Agents and a low-cost inference provider stealing keys both point to the same conclusion: the trust and security boundaries of Agents are becoming the real bottleneck for deployment.

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol Answer More Concisely, but Lag Behind Claude on Transparency
items.desc: OpenAI's new models give shorter, more direct answers but are less willing to admit uncertainty; Anthropic's Claude series clearly leads in transparency evaluations.
items.value: Weigh "conciseness" vs. "honesty" when choosing models; use with caution in high-risk scenarios

items.title: NVIDIA Releases Alpamayo 2 Edge: A 2B Reasoning VLA for DRIVE Thor
items.desc: The model can plan driving trajectories and explain its reasoning, with pixel-to-trajectory latency of only 160–190ms, deployable on the vehicle side.
items.value: Small-parameter VLA on vehicles; a reference for edge-side autonomous driving inference

items.title: Google Previews Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
items.desc: Agents can keep a large tool library resident and load the corresponding parameter schema only when needed within a single Interactions API request.
items.value: Directly alleviates context bloat and cost issues with large tool libraries

items.title: Perplexity Launches Monitor API
items.desc: Searches the web on a schedule and notifies agents via webhook only when relevant changes are detected, with a built-in decision model to filter noise.
items.value: Turns search from a one-off query into a continuous monitoring agent capability

items.title: AWS Launches TorchNeuron: PyTorch Models Run on Trainium Without Modification
items.desc: Lowers the barrier to using non-NVIDIA accelerators.
items.value: Lower migration cost boosts Trainium ecosystem competitiveness

items.title: Major US Banks Ban Third-Party AI Agents from Logging into Accounts
items.desc: Multiple financial institutions prohibit third-party bots from accessing user accounts and state that losses caused by bots are borne by users themselves.
items.value: Personal finance agents hit a compliance wall; product design must avoid this in advance

items.title: METR Warns: Models Are Improving Faster Than Safety Evaluation Capabilities
items.desc: Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra improve rapidly on research tasks yet become increasingly hard to measure, and existing data cannot rule out dangerous acceleration; meanwhile, common tests may overestimate models' actual capabilities.
items.value: Evaluation methods themselves are the bottleneck; benchmark credibility needs re-examination

items.title: OpenAI Chief Scientist on How to "Limit the Speed" of AI Development
items.desc: The core difficulty is first reaching consensus on "how to measure speed."
items.value: Governance debate shifts to quantifiable metrics; evaluation standards may become a policy lever

items.title: Coding agents complete fewer than 10% of tasks in a simulated workplace
items.desc: A new benchmark places agents in a simulated developer job with colleagues, project boards, and incomplete handoffs; both Opus 5.5 and Astra fall far short—excelling on isolated tests but losing focus on autonomous long-term development.
items.value: Exposes the huge gap between benchmark gaming and real engineering ability

items.title: Lean/Mathlib community officially confirms Levent Alpöge's proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is correct
items.desc: Dozens of independent verifiers checked 17 million lines of code, decades ahead of Terence Tao's predicted 2050.
items.value: Formal verification becomes a trusted arbiter for AI math results

items.title: TensorLean: Formally verifying GPU kernels at the PTX level
items.desc: From Columbia and CertiK, it checks 149 kernel instances, proves 83 correct, and finds 38 bugs in FlashAttention, DeepGEMM, and others.
items.value: Provides provable correctness guarantees for high-performance operators

items.title: LightningMoBA: Dynamic routing + KV-centric execution accelerate block-sparse attention
items.desc: Targeting MoBA's fixed Top-k budget and query-centric scheduling flaws, it jointly designs selection and execution.
items.value: A direct engineering path to faster long-context inference

items.title: Tencent Yuanbao × KCL release the first agent memory benchmark built from group chats
items.desc: An exam built from 80,000 group chat messages tests agents' long-term memory capabilities.
items.value: Provides a realistic evaluation set for agent memory capability

items.title: Claude-BugHunter gains 1,716 stars in a single day
items.desc: A Claude Code skill pack with 82 skills, 15 slash commands, and 681 public report patterns covering 24 vulnerability classes, aimed at red teaming and vulnerability discovery.
items.value: Agent skill engineering for security can be reused directly

items.title: DeepSeek V1 author's startup project goes open source, built for locally deployed Agents
items.desc: An Agent framework focused on localized operation.
items.value: Adds another high-profile option for locally deployed Agents

items.title: Karpo's new open-source work: a browser Agent balancing speed and results
items.desc: It previously surpassed Gemini.
items.value: A performance benchmark reference for browser automation Agents

items.title: localcode: run open-source agentic coding on a Mac with one command
items.desc: A locally run coding Agent tool.
items.value: Lowers the barrier to trying local coding Agents

items.title: Agent swarm takes on P vs. NP, sparking fierce debate in tech circles
items.desc: pequalnp.com uses a swarm of Agents to attempt to crack P vs. NP, scoring 92 points and 82 comments on HN; ACM simultaneously published a piece revisiting "What Happened in Fall 2026: AI and P vs. NP." The discussion centers on whether mathematical results produced by multi-Agent collaboration can be verified, and how they should be interpreted.
items.value: A debate over the feasibility and credibility of Agent swarms in frontier research

items.title: "You are an LLM's subagent" game hits HN's front page
items.desc: The Show HN project worker755 lets players act as an LLM's subagent executing tasks, with 266 points and 61 comments, reflecting developers' collective resonance with Agent hierarchical collaboration and the experience of "being scheduled."
items.value: Understanding the real pain points of subagent orchestration through a gamified lens
